interpolation_assumption: Use the frozen adjacent-node regional projection operator unchanged: piecewise linear primary model lower contour only between eligible original neighbors; paired upper depth/layer span only with paired supported endpoints. Preserve source-order nodes, blocked exact locations and both adjacent gaps. No threshold substitution, skipping, extrapolation, widening search, inferred seabed or current-axis validation. Editorial reference geometry does not replace current length.
projection_inventory_rule: A new case must contain at least one eligible lower-depth source node to enter projections and its ownership count. Fully blocked cases remain in unresolved_reference_cases with every original node, source value/pointer and block reason. Their projected values stay unknown, they are excluded from projectionCSV and they do not count as supported regional projection coverage. Export their raw evidence in a separately typed unresolvedCSV. Preserve prior35projection objects unchanged.
interpretation: Six dated North Brazil/North Atlantic/Labrador reference cases are assessed from frozen220velocity profiles. Keep original per-object10cm/s(North Brazil)/5cm/s(North Atlantic/Labrador) primaries and branch exclusions. Fully blocked reference corridors are evidence of a failed axis bracket or missing support, not current absence and not usable depth-profile coverage. Interior resolved model descriptors remain conditional regional scenarios; no physical thickness, volume, annual envelope or independent axis claim. All previous35objects and CSVcells remain preserved.
processing_policy: Cloud-only classification/geometry/interpolation/tests on one idle CPU using frozen sources. Local metadata/code/proof retention only; no field retrieval, numerical tests, native/WASM/browser/server/runtime/UI changes.
